module: Flowgraph node "Start Drag Race" (category once_instant). Starts the drag race activity, to be called after the vehicles are set up. Input pin: lane (hidden, optional, freeroam context). Outputs: flow (pulse) and success. Fails if the data is not loaded or if the race is already started.

workOnce.desc: Calls dragBridge.startDragRaceActivity(lane) after checks and fills success; flow is always activated.
